authentication_and_storage.security_analysis: While tab-partitioned sessionStorage isolates credentials between concurrent tabs, tokens are accessible to client JavaScript and vulnerable to origin-level XSS. Refresh tokens in sessionStorage can be exfiltrated if an XSS flaw exists.
authentication_and_storage.logout_behavior: logout() calls /api/v1/auth/logout with refresh_token and clears the active tab sessionStorage via clearTabSession(). However, other open tabs are not synchronously cleared until they make an API call and receive 401.

oauth_frontend_flow.flow_type: Google OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code with State & Nonce
oauth_frontend_flow.url_history_hygiene: DEFECTIVE: Uses router.push() instead of router.replace(), leaving authorization code and state in browser history, causing replay error upon clicking browser Back button.
oauth_frontend_flow.replay_handling: requestSentRef prevents React StrictMode double-execution; backend enforces single-use state.

role_based_ui_and_authorization.enforcement_layer: Client-Side Only (useEffect in pages and AppShell; no Next.js server middleware.ts)
role_based_ui_and_authorization.security_boundary_status: NOT A SECURITY BOUNDARY. Client-side checks hide navigation items, but unauthenticated and unauthorized users can download JavaScript bundles containing administrative routes and schemas.
role_based_ui_and_authorization.api_parity: UI relies on backend HTTP 401/403 responses for true security enforcement.

sensitive_legal_data_exposure.browser_storage: No case contents or evidence stored in localStorage; theme preferences only. Temporary state held in React component memory.
sensitive_legal_data_exposure.url_leakage: Case IDs, consultation IDs, and document IDs passed in URLs (UUIDv4/UUIDv7). No PII or passwords in URLs.
sensitive_legal_data_exposure.time_bypass_leakage: Consultation room reads ?bypass_time=true or ?test=true from URL and sends to backend API, exposing test bypass controls to end users.
sensitive_legal_data_exposure.account_switch_leakage: Component state is wiped upon page navigation; AuthProvider resets user state on logout.

api_error_handling.hierarchy: Typed ApiError classes (NetworkError, AuthenticationError, AuthorizationError, NotFoundError, ConflictError, ValidationError, RateLimitError, ServerError)
api_error_handling.auto_refresh_on_401: Intercepts 401, calls performTokenRefresh(), queues concurrent requests, and retries original request once on success.
api_error_handling.swallowed_errors: Certain pages use .catch(() => null) or .catch(() => ({ items: [] })) which can mask silent network failures in dashboard widgets.

mutation_safety_and_idempotency.duplicate_click_protection: Implemented via local state (e.g. creating, submitting, isEndingCall, requestSentRef).
mutation_safety_and_idempotency.idempotency_keys: Frontend does NOT generate or transmit Idempotency-Key headers for case creation, payments, or consultation booking.
mutation_safety_and_idempotency.optimistic_updates: Minimal optimistic updates; UI predominantly awaits backend confirmation before state refresh.

state_machine_consistency.case_status_parity: Frontend recognizes OPEN, IN_PROGRESS, CLOSED, CANCELLED.
state_machine_consistency.consultation_status_parity: Frontend maps REQUESTED, PAID, ACCEPTED, SCHEDULED, IN_PROGRESS, COMPLETED, CANCELLED.
state_machine_consistency.flaw_exposure: Exposes Phase 3 BL-FIND-04: Full refund in commercial UI causes consultation to display as CANCELLED even if previously attended.

file_upload_security.upload_method: Presigned S3/MinIO URLs (init_upload -> PUT to S3 -> complete_upload).
file_upload_security.client_validation: File size and MIME type validated in UI before initiating upload.
file_upload_security.critical_vulnerability: Cases page (cases/[caseId]/page.tsx:368) calls development mock endpoint POST /api/v1/documents/${doc.id}/scan?is_safe=true during production upload flow to force document status to SAFE.

xss_and_dom_security.dangerouslySetInnerHTML: 1 occurrence in frontend/src/app/layout.tsx: theme initialization script and hydration error filter. Static string only, no user data interpolated.
xss_and_dom_security.markdown_rendering: Custom regex parser in ai-advisor/page.tsx: splits on **bold** and renders native React <strong> tags. React escapes interpolated strings.
xss_and_dom_security.verdict: Low XSS risk; DOM sinks are strictly guarded by React JSX auto-escaping.

csrf_and_cors.csrf_protection: Reads csrf_token cookie and attaches X-CSRF-Token header to all non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS requests.
csrf_and_cors.credentials: fetchOptions.credentials = 'include' for cross-origin or proxied requests.

security_headers.csp_status: Implemented in next.config.ts with 'unsafe-inline' in script-src.

dependencies.vulnerabilities: Requires Windows patch-fs.js shim to prevent EISDIR crash on fs.readlinkSync.
